title: IN WHICH PASSEPARTOUT UNDERGOES, AT A SPEED OF TWENTY MILES AN HOUR, A COURSE OF MORMON HISTORY
summary_hover: A Mormon missionary lectures on the train as they approach Utah; later, the group briefly visits Salt Lake City.
summary_detail: As the train travels towards the Great Salt Lake, a Mormon missionary, Elder William Hitch, delivers a lecture on Mormon history in one of the cars, with Passepartout eventually becoming his only listener. The train arrives in Ogden, allowing Fogg and his party time to visit Salt Lake City via a branch line before returning to the train. Just as they depart, a fleeing Mormon boards the train to escape his single, overbearing wife.
